sequence: M09 tests remote-region coarsening. Then evaluate local LE/TE refinement with a coarser middle chord in a targeted M10 candidate; use M11–M15 only if further evidence is needed. Complete matched temporal checks and stop adding meshes once supported.
controls: Change one resolution family at a time; preserve exact source foil and single-cell span. No domain shrink. Audit zero invalid cells, positive volume/closure, wall y+, transition, force components, CFL and actual computing time.
acceptance: Both mean CL and CD within1% of comparable denser evidence; both adjacent0.2s mean changes below0.5%; no automatic validation from low cell count. Final-mesh time-step verification required.

mapped_restart.finding: STAR 2602 supports solution interpolation on remeshing or mesh replacement. Higher-order stencil is recommended for transient analysis. Conservative correction is available only for supported model combinations.
mapped_restart.limitation: Our workflow rebuilds/imports an exact one-cell-span CGNS region. Automatic interpolation is not yet established for that replacement. VOF and SST compatibility and conservation correction must be checked in the actual continuum; do not assume support.
mapped_restart.experiment: On a new attempt copied from an accepted checkpoint, retain region identity and replace the mesh using supported mesh-replacement/mapping. Verify phase bounds and total water volume, finite pressure/velocity/turbulence, surface continuity and force transients. Re-settle independently. A matched cold-start check is required before treating mapping as a validated time saver.
mapped_restart.action: Do not change the running M08 or initialize M09 from a mapped field before this audit.
